query: What visit-note signals suggest a longer visit?

per_column.name: visit_type
per_column.rationale: Category of visit is knowable independent of duration and plausibly correlates with how long a visit runs; a legitimate upstream predictor.

per_column.name: clinical_severity_level
per_column.rationale: Severity is a clinical characteristic of the case that is not a component of duration and could drive longer visits; valid predictor.

per_column.name: new_diagnosis_flag
per_column.rationale: Whether a new diagnosis was made is a case attribute that plausibly extends visit time without being a restatement of duration.

per_column.name: chronic_disease_count
per_column.rationale: Patient comorbidity burden is an independent characteristic that can lengthen visits; legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: diagnostic_test_ordered
per_column.rationale: Ordering tests is a within-visit activity co-occurring with duration; borderline for potential co-determination, but it is not a deterministic function of duration and carries genuine predictive signal, so accepted as predictor.

per_column.name: new_medication_initiated
per_column.rationale: Medication changes reflect visit complexity and plausibly add time; not a restatement of duration, so a valid predictor.

per_column.name: specialist_consult_triggered
per_column.rationale: Triggering a consult signals complexity/added activity that lengthens a visit; independent of the duration value itself.

per_column.name: counseling_topic
per_column.rationale: Presence and type of counseling is an activity indicator plausibly associated with longer visits and not a direct component of duration.

per_column.name: outbound_referral_count
per_column.rationale: Number of referrals reflects visit complexity and is not a restatement or deterministic function of duration; carries predictive signal.

judge.rationale: All added columns are case/activity characteristics that lie outside the duration variable itself, none restate or deterministically encode minutes, and none are post-outcome leakage. As a set they capture visit complexity, severity, comorbidity, and in-visit actions -- strong, diverse predictive leverage. Some columns (tests ordered, referrals, consults) are contemporaneous activities that partly co-determine duration and mildly overlap, so utility is high but not maximal.
